claim: Development-only BM25 lexical lower-bound Stage 3 baseline (v3, candidate-specific). v1/v2 were invalid: their similarity function ignored the candidate text (best-document score of the action corpus for every candidate), so action mapping always picked the first action, actor/business-object comparison queried the action corpus, and out-of-order endpoints could map to the wrong action. v3 provides candidate-specific scoring over per-domain candidate pools (action corpus vs actor/business-object corpus) with a real [0,1] normalization. Matching evaluated primarily by ranking AP/MAP; binary rule (score > tau) is a fixed development setting, NOT a blind/confirmatory preregistration (the developer had seen the same 58 development Gold items and other method results; benchmark exposure cannot be fully excluded).

supersedes.v1: superseded_invalid_candidate_agnostic_similarity (sim ignored candidate text; results not usable for comparison, registry active methods, or the paper)
supersedes.v2: superseded_invalid_candidate_agnostic_similarity (same defect; sensitivity repair in v2 did not change the similarity function)

method.tokenizer: lowercase alphanumeric tokens (no stopword removal: lexical lower bound)

bm25.note: Okapi BM25 defaults; b genuinely affects length normalisation

actor.documents: the process model's actor/pool/lane names plus business-object texts

retrieval_domains.note: separate candidate pools per domain; actor/BO scores never reuse the action corpus

method.scoring: candidate-specific BM25: score(query, candidate) uses the candidate's own term frequencies and length, IDF/length statistics from the domain pool
method.normalization: score / sum(IDF(t)*(k1+1)) over unique query terms; each term contribution IDF*tf*(k1+1)/(tf + k1*(1-b+b*dl/avgdl)) is < 1 for all tf/dl, so the result is truly in [0,1]; repeated query tokens are collapsed for the bound; empty query/candidate/pool yields 0.0
method.tie_breaking: best match = max score with first-seen action order (stable parsed order); duplicate labels map to the first parsed action id deterministically
method.matching_formula: matching_score = max(avg best rule-action BM25, avg best rule-actor BM25)
method.violation_semantics: mapping mirrors Sun Definitions 5-7 structure with BM25 similarity; gamma and theta DO change mappings, R/C sets, denominators and observability, so sensitivity must re-instantiate the scorer (see baseline_stage3_sensitivity.py)
method.empty_semantics: empty query/candidate/pool -> score 0.0, no match, never silently compliant

thresholds.note: fixed development setting chosen from the method's lexical semantics BEFORE this run; the developer had already seen the same 58 development Gold items and other method results, so this is NOT a statistically blind/confirmatory preregistration and benchmark exposure cannot be fully excluded. Sweeps are diagnostic only; primary values never selected from the sweep.

inputs.note: runner reads ONLY the inference pack; no decision/candidate/evidence fields

evaluator.note: same common evaluator and same 58 item IDs as Winter/Sun
